static_traits.name: Chen Kai
static_traits.family_status: Living with two roommates, keeping two dogs
static_traits.medical_history: No previous similar psychological problems and treatment history; no significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Expresses clearly, highly cooperative, slightly tense, able to reflect on own thoughts and emotions

basic_info.main_problem: Feelings of inadequacy and low self-esteem related to cooking skills: after burning rice a few months ago, I labeled myself a 'terrible cook'; since then, every time I enter the kitchen or think about cooking I feel tense and stressed, I gradually avoid cooking, worry about making mistakes and being judged, and the negative self-talk continues.
basic_info.core_demands: Persistent fear and negative self-talk about cooking skills have begun to affect daily life and physical and mental health, so the client seeks counseling to change this state.
growth_experiences: A few months ago, Chen Kai burned the rice while cooking; he regarded this as a 'basic error', which produced a strong sense of incompetence, labeling a single mistake as 'I am a terrible cook'. Since then, whenever he enters the kitchen or thinks about cooking, he feels stress and tension, and has gradually avoided cooking, fearing making mistakes again and being judged; he tried watching cooking tutorials and asking friends for advice, but the negative emotions and thoughts persisted.
Before burning the rice, Chen Kai often cooked for himself and received praise and positive feedback from friends, but in the current distress, he feels these positive experiences 'do not count'.

special_situations.event: Burned the rice a few months ago
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot even cook the most basic rice properly, it means I am overall very poor and a terrible cook
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: At first, compensated by watching tutorials and asking friends for advice; afterward gradually turned to avoiding cooking to reduce the risk of failure
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am so bad; I am just a terrible cook

special_situations.event: Whenever entering the kitchen or thinking about cooking
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I make another mistake, it will prove I am no good, and I may be judged by others
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids entering the kitchen and cooking
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am going to mess up again

special_situations.event: Scenes of cooking with roommates or involving division of labor
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not do well, my roommate will think I am weak/incompetent
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Lets roommates take on the cooking and steps back to avoid exposing shortcomings
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am bad at this; I had better not add to the mess

special_situations.event: Recalling past cooking experiences praised by friends
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One failure can negate all past successes
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignores or devalues past successes and focuses only on that one mistake

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized as capable, to be accepted, and to share and connect with roommates
core_conflict.fear: Afraid of being judged and humiliated for making mistakes, and then seen as incapable
defense_goal: Avoids exposing weaknesses to protect self-esteem
Reducing the risk of being evaluated by avoiding cooking and putting oneself down

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When advised to communicate with roommates or cook together, or when seeing with their own eyes the roommate busy in the kitchen
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Others will pick at me like judges and see me as incompetent
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Says 'I had better not participate' in a withdrawn, self-deprecating tone, reduces eye contact, weakens self-needs, and changes the topic.

manifestations: Avoids cooking together with roommates out of fear of failure and being evaluated
Not expressing fear and worry about cooking to roommate, reducing interaction and support
outcomes: Reduced connection and shared time with roommate, producing relationship alienation and guilt

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: Worries about appearing weak or incompetent, and so avoids participating in cooking
When discussing returning to the kitchen, repeatedly raises the worry 'what if I make a mistake again', being very cautious

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Assuming the roommate will judge him as incompetent, thus choosing to avoid cooking together
Believes 'they can handle it very well; it is better if I do not take part', using others' position as a reason to avoid exposing the self

positive_force: Has had good cooking experiences and received positive feedback from friends
Willing to try small steps; expresses 'willing to give it a try'
Able to notice and describe automatic thoughts (such as 'I am going to mess up again')
Having roommates as a potential social support resource
Having proactively looked for solutions (watching tutorials, asking friends for advice)
negative_force: Overgeneralization and self-labeling, viewing one failure as overall incompetence
Mind-reading-style worries and high dependence on external evaluation
A personalization tendency aggravates shame and low self-esteem
Avoidance reduces anxiety in the short term but maintains the problem long-term
Disqualifies positive experiences; hard to integrate past successful experiences

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids cooking and entering the kitchen
antecedent: Seeing roommates cooking or matters involving division of labor
target_behavior.core_reason: After burning rice once, personalized the failure and overgeneralized it as a lack of ability, worrying about making another mistake and being judged
target_behavior.function: Escaping possible failure and being evaluated, reducing anxiety in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Eating is disrupted and shifts toward unhealthy choices; division of labor and connection with roommates are impaired; self-esteem keeps declining

target_behavior.behavior: Negative self-talk and self-labeling (such as 'I will mess it up' 'I am a terrible cook')
antecedent: Before preparing to cook or cooking
Recalling the experience of burning the rice
target_behavior.core_reason: Low sense of self-worth is activated, interpreting failure in a labeling manner and reinforcing feelings of incompetence
target_behavior.function: Reducing investment and expectations through self-deprecation, to avoid attempts and potential failure
target_behavior.consequence: Anxiety rises, opportunities for practice and improvement decrease, further reinforcing avoidance
